headline: Jindal Supreme appoints Somnath Arora as Plant Head
hook: Leadership change at Jindal Supreme plant
summary: Jindal Supreme (India) Limited has informed the stock exchange about the appointment of Somnath Arora as Plant Head and Senior Management Personnel. The appointment takes effect from October 8, 2026. Such routine senior management updates have minimal immediate impact on share price or retail investor portfolios. For Indian retail investors, this is standard corporate governance filing data.
why_it_matters: Routine management update with no direct impact on retail portfolios
